question_english: Which of the following best delineates the fundamental scope of educational management as distinct from general administration?
options_english: The execution of institutional policies to achieve predetermined educational objectives through the optimal coordination of human and material resources
The strict enforcement of statutory financial regulations and bureaucratic disciplinary procedures
The macro-level formulation of broad national policies and overall educational structures
The exclusive focus on classroom pedagogical instruction and direct academic transaction
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Educational management focuses fundamentally on mobilizing, coordinating, and optimizing human, physical, and financial resources to systematically execute institutional policies and attain predetermined pedagogical goals. While general administration is primarily concerned with macro-level regulatory governance, statutory rule formulation, and routine bureaucratic oversight, educational management actively integrates administrative functions with teaching-learning processes to enhance academic quality and institutional effectiveness. Option (b) describes a narrow bureaucratic control mechanism. Option (c) pertains to educational policy-making at the governmental level rather than organizational management. Option (d) describes classroom teaching methodology, which is a pedagogical activity supported by management rather than the definition of management itself.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। शैक्षिक प्रबंधन का मुख्य केंद्रबिंदु मानवीय, भौतिक और वित्तीय संसाधनों का योजनाबद्ध समन्वय व उपयोग करके संस्थागत नीतियों को क्रियान्वित करना तथा पूर्व-निर्धारित शैक्षणिक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करना है। जहाँ सामान्य प्रशासन मुख्य रूप से व्यापक विनियामक शासन, वैधानिक नियमों के निर्धारण और नियमित नौकरशाही निरीक्षण तक सीमित रहता है, वहीं शैक्षिक प्रबंधन प्रशासनिक प्रक्रियाओं को शिक्षण-अधिगम गतिविधियों से जोड़ता है ताकि संस्थागत प्रगति और गुणवत्तापूर्ण शिक्षा सुनिश्चित हो सके। विकल्प (b) केवल नियमित नियम प्रवर्तन को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (c) शासन स्तर पर नीति-निर्माण से संबंधित है। विकल्प (d) शिक्षण पद्धति का हिस्सा है, जो प्रबंधन का एक घटक तो है परंतु इसका समग्र कार्यक्षेत्र नहीं है।

It integrates managerial functions with pedagogical objectives to facilitate effective teaching, learning outcomes, and institutional progress.

question_english: Within the classic POSDCORB framework of administrative functions formulated by Luther Gulick, which element specifically involves keeping supervisory authorities, oneself, and subordinates informed regarding institutional operations through comprehensive records, research, and inspection?
options_english: Organizing
Directing
Reporting
Co-ordinating
explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). In Luther Gulick's classic administrative framework 'POSDCORB' (Planning, Organizing, Staffing, Directing, Coordinating, Reporting, and Budgeting), 'Reporting' (R) represents the systematic mechanism of keeping executive authorities, supervisors, and team members fully informed about ongoing organizational activities. This function is accomplished through maintaining accurate administrative records, conducting educational research, carrying out periodic inspections, and disseminating evaluative reports. Option (a), Organizing, involves establishing formal structures of authority and task division. Option (b), Directing, entails continuous decision-making and issuing operational instructions. Option (d), Coordinating, focuses on interrelating and harmonizing the various parts of the organization.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। लूथर गुलिक द्वारा प्रतिपादित प्रशासनिक कार्यों के 'POSDCORB' प्रारूप (योजना, संगठन, कर्मचारी चयन, निर्देशन, समन्वय, प्रतिवेदन तथा बजट निर्माण) में 'रिपोर्टिंग' (प्रतिवेदन) वह महत्वपूर्ण प्रक्रिया है जिसके माध्यम से उच्च अधिकारियों, स्वयं प्रशासक और सहकर्मियों को संस्था की कार्यप्रणाली तथा प्रगति की निरंतर जानकारी दी जाती है। यह कार्य सुव्यवस्थित अभिलेखों के संधारण, शोध और नियमित निरीक्षण द्वारा संपन्न होता है। विकल्प (a) 'संगठन' अधिकारों और कार्यों की औपचारिक संरचना तैयार करने से संबंधित है। विकल्प (b) 'निर्देशन' निर्णयों और आदेशों के परिचालन से संबंधित है। विकल्प (d) 'समन्वय' विभिन्न विभागों व गतिविधियों के मध्य सामंजस्य स्थापित करने का कार्य है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Reporting in administrative management involves keeping executive authorities, supervisors, and team members informed about ongoing organizational activities. Within the POSDCORB framework, this function relies on maintaining accurate records, conducting regular research, performing periodic inspections, and disseminating performance data. Continuous communication ensures organizational transparency, accountability, and informed decision-making across all operational levels within an institution.

question_english: In educational management, planning is regarded as the primary managerial function. Which of the following best characterizes 'Institutional Planning' at the school level?
options_english: A bottom-up, participatory plan formulated collaboratively by the school community based on its felt needs and available resources
A top-down directive imposed uniformly by the Directorate of Education primarily for statutory financial compliance
A reactive contingency strategy formulated strictly to manage unforeseen operational crises in the school
A rigid, standardized instructional timetable template prescribed uniformly across all government schools
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Institutional planning, as conceptualized by educational commissions including the Kothari Commission (1964-66), is a democratic, decentralized, and bottom-up planning process. It is formulated collaboratively by school administrators, teachers, parents, and community members to fulfill the specific, felt needs of an individual institution using existing and readily available human, physical, and financial resources. Option (b) represents rigid bureaucratic centralization rather than institutional planning. Option (c) refers to crisis management or contingency planning. Option (d) describes an instructional scheduling tool, not a comprehensive institutional developmental plan.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। कोठारी आयोग (1964-66) की अनुशंसाओं के अनुसार, संस्थागत नियोजन एक विकेंद्रीकृत, लोकतांत्रिक और सहभागितापूर्ण (नीचे-से-ऊपर) प्रक्रिया है। इसे विद्यालय के प्रधानाचार्य, शिक्षकों और स्थानीय समुदाय द्वारा मिलकर विद्यालय की विशिष्ट आवश्यकताओं, प्राथमिकताओं तथा उपलब्ध संसाधनों को ध्यान में रखकर तैयार किया जाता है। विकल्प (b) केंद्रीकृत नौकरशाही दृष्टिकोण का परिचायक है जो संस्थागत स्वायत्तता के विरुद्ध है। विकल्प (c) संकट प्रबंधन या आकस्मिक योजना से संबंधित है। विकल्प (d) केवल एक दैनिक समय-सारणी है, जो संस्थागत नियोजन का एक छोटा सा घटक हो सकती है, समग्र योजना नहीं।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A bottom-up plan prepared by the school community based on its felt needs and available resources

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Institutional planning functions as a bottom-up administrative process created collaboratively by school leadership, teachers, and the local community. It evaluates the specific needs, capabilities, and resources of an individual institution to formulate tailored improvement strategies. Rather than following rigid external directives, institutional planning empowers local stakeholders to address unique educational challenges and optimize resource utilization effectively.

question_english:
Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Institutional planning in a school must remain inherently flexible and subject to periodic, continuous evaluation.
Reason (R): Educational institutions function in dynamic socio-environmental contexts where student requirements, pedagogical innovations, and resource conditions evolve continuously.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)

explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Institutional planning cannot be a static, rigid blueprint; it must remain flexible and responsive to emerging educational realities. Therefore, continuous monitoring and periodic review are vital to adapt operational strategies to these environmental changes. Hence, both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and (R) correctly explains (A).
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। संस्थागत नियोजन कोई अपरिवर्तनीय या जड़ दस्तावेज नहीं हो सकता; इसे व्यावहारिक, लचीला और सतत समीक्षा के योग्य होना चाहिए। विद्यालय एक खुली और गतिशील सामाजिक व्यवस्था का हिस्सा होते हैं जहाँ छात्रों की रुचियाँ, सीखने की शैलियाँ, सरकारी नीतियाँ और संसाधनों की उपलब्धता निरंतर बदलती रहती हैं। इन परिवर्तनों के अनुरूप विद्यालयीन रणनीतियों को अनुकूलित करने के लिए नियमित आवधिक मूल्यांकन अत्यंत आवश्यक है। अतः अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या प्रस्तुत करता है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Institutional planning requires adaptability and continuous evaluation because educational environments are inherently dynamic. Regular reviews allow administrators to adjust operational strategies to meet emerging needs, maintain academic quality, and optimize resource utilization effectively.

question_english:
In administrative management theory, Herbert Simon's rational decision-making model comprises specific sequential phases. Which of the following represents the correct sequential order of these phases?
I. Design activity (inventing, developing, and analyzing possible courses of action)
II. Intelligence activity (scanning the organizational environment for conditions requiring a decision)
III. Choice activity (selecting and implementing a particular course of action among alternatives)
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
options_english: I, II, III
II, I, III
III, I, II
II, III, I
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (b). Nobel laureate Herbert Simon formulated a pioneering three-phase model of the rational decision-making process:
1. Intelligence Activity: The initial search and scanning of the organizational environment to identify problems or situations requiring managerial decisions.
2. Design Activity: The creative process of inventing, developing, and analyzing potential alternative courses of action to address the identified problem.
3. Choice Activity: The critical evaluative process of selecting a specific course of action from among the available alternatives and implementing it.
Therefore, the proper chronological sequence is II -> I -> III.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता हर्बर्ट साइमन द्वारा प्रस्तुत विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय-निर्माण मॉडल में मुख्य रूप से तीन चरण सम्मिलित हैं:
1. आसूचना / बौद्धिक गतिविधि (Intelligence Activity): वातावरण का सर्वेक्षण करना ताकि उन परिस्थितियों की पहचान की जा सके जिनके समाधान हेतु निर्णय लेना आवश्यक है।
2. प्रारूपण / डिजाइन गतिविधि (Design Activity): समस्या के समाधान हेतु विभिन्न संभावित विकल्पों और कार्य-प्रणालियों का निर्माण, विकास तथा उनका विश्लेषण करना।
3. चयन गतिविधि (Choice Activity): तैयार किए गए विभिन्न विकल्पों में से सर्वोत्तम विकल्प का चयन करना तथा उसे लागू करना।
अतः सही तार्किक और कालानुक्रमिक क्रम II -> I -> III है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) II, I, III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Herbert Simon’s model of rational decision-making follows a structured three-phase sequence: Intelligence, Design, and Choice. The intelligence phase scans internal and external environments to detect conditions requiring decisions. Next, the design phase invents, develops, and analyzes alternative courses of action. Finally, the choice phase selects the most appropriate alternative, ensuring logical, objective, and effective organizational problem-solving.

question_hindi: एक विद्यालय की प्रधानाचार्या पाती हैं कि अत्यधिक प्रशासनिक कार्यभार के कारण शैक्षणिक प्राथमिकताओं और शिक्षण-अधिगम मुद्दों के समाधान में विलंब हो रहा है। इस स्थिति से निपटने के लिए, वह मध्याह्न भोजन (मिड-डे मील) योजना के प्रबंधन और अभिलेख संधारण का दायित्व एक वरिष्ठ शिक्षक को सौंपती हैं तथा उन्हें मांग-पत्रों (इन्डेंट फॉर्म्स) पर हस्ताक्षर करने का प्राधिकार देती हैं, जबकि अंतिम उत्तरदायित्व (जवाबदेही) स्वयं अपने पास रखती हैं। प्रधानाचार्या यहाँ किस प्रबंधकीय सिद्धांत को लागू कर रही हैं?

question_english: A school Principal observes that an excessive administrative workload is causing significant delays in addressing core instructional and academic priorities. To resolve this, she entrusts the operational responsibility of managing the Mid-Day Meal scheme and inventory records to a senior teacher, vesting him with the requisite authority to sign indent forms, while retaining ultimate administrative accountability herself. Which managerial principle is the Principal operationalizing?
options_english: Centralization
Divestment
Delegation of Authority
Decentralization
explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Delegation of authority is the administrative process through which a manager assigns operational duties and entrusts commensurate authority to a subordinate to perform specific tasks, while the delegator retains ultimate responsibility and accountability for the final outcome. In administrative theory, authority and responsibility can be delegated, but accountability cannot be abdicated. Option (a), Centralization, retains all decision-making authority at the top management level. Option (b), Divestment, refers to selling off organizational assets or shedding operations. Option (d), Decentralization, represents a systemic, organization-wide structural dispersion of decision-making powers to lower administrative units, whereas this scenario depicts an individual superior-to-subordinate assignment.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। प्राधिकार का प्रत्यायोजन (Delegation of Authority) वह प्रबंधकीय प्रक्रिया है जिसके अंतर्गत कोई अधिकारी अपने नियमित कार्यभार को कम करने हेतु किसी विशिष्ट कार्य का दायित्व और आवश्यक अधिकार अपने अधीनस्थ को सौंपता है। यहाँ ध्यान देने योग्य बात यह है कि कार्य और अधिकार तो सौंपे जा सकते हैं, परंतु अंतिम उत्तरदायित्व या जवाबदेही (Accountability) सदैव मूल अधिकारी की ही बनी रहती है। विकल्प (a) केंद्रीकरण में सभी निर्णय शीर्ष स्तर पर लिए जाते हैं। विकल्प (b) विनिवेश परिसंपत्तियों की बिक्री से संबंधित है। विकल्प (d) विकेंद्रीकरण संपूर्ण संगठन स्तर पर निर्णय लेने की शक्तियों के व्यापक प्रसार की नीति को दर्शाता है, जबकि यह एक अधिकारी से एक अधीनस्थ के मध्य दायित्व हस्तांतरण का व्यक्तिगत उदाहरण है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Delegation involves transferring responsibility and necessary authority from a manager to a subordinate to perform specific organizational tasks. However, ultimate accountability remains with the delegating authority. This managerial process optimizes institutional efficiency, alleviates executive workload, enhances staff competence, and ensures administrative continuity without diluting structural governance or overall organizational responsibility.

question_hindi: हेनरी फेयोल द्वारा प्रतिपादित संगठन का कौन-सा शास्त्रीय प्रशासनिक सिद्धांत यह निर्धारित करता है कि किसी कर्मचारी को केवल एक ही उच्चाधिकारी से आदेश प्राप्त होने चाहिए और वह उसी के प्रति जवाबदेह होना चाहिए?
options_hindi: निर्देश की एकरूपता (Unity of Direction)

question_english: Which classical administrative principle, formulated by Henri Fayol, establishes that an organizational employee should receive operational orders from and report directly to only one superior authority?
options_english: Unity of Direction
Unity of Command
Scalar Chain
Span of Control
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Henri Fayol's principle of 'Unity of Command' asserts that an employee must receive operational instructions and directives from only one single direct superior, and be held answerable only to that superior. Violating this principle creates role conflict, divided loyalty, administrative chaos, and breakdown of operational discipline. Option (a), Unity of Direction, states that there should be 'one head and one plan' for a group of activities having the same organizational objective. Option (c), Scalar Chain, is the hierarchical line of authority running from top management to frontline staff. Option (d), Span of Control, denotes the number of subordinates an executive can supervise effectively.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। हेनरी फेयोल के 14 प्रबंधकीय सिद्धांतों में 'आदेश की एकता' (Unity of Command) का सिद्धांत यह स्पष्ट करता है कि प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को एक समय में केवल एक ही अधिकारी से आदेश मिलने चाहिए। यदि किसी कर्मचारी को एक से अधिक अधिकारियों से परस्पर विरोधी निर्देश मिलेंगे, तो कार्य में भ्रम, अनुशासनहीनता और प्रशासनिक अव्यवस्था उत्पन्न होगी। विकल्प (a) 'निर्देश की एकरूपता' समान उद्देश्य वाली गतिविधियों के लिए 'एक प्रमुख और एक योजना' पर बल देता है। विकल्प (c) 'सोपान श्रृंखला' सर्वोच्च अधिकारी से लेकर निम्नतम स्तर तक प्राधिकार की पदसोपानिक रेखा है। विकल्प (d) 'नियंत्रण का विस्तार' यह बताता है कि एक अधिकारी कितने अधीनस्थों का प्रभावी ढंग से पर्यवेक्षण कर सकता है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Unity of Command

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Unity of command dictates that each employee reports to and receives instructions from only one direct superior. This principle prevents conflicting orders, role ambiguity, administrative friction, and divided accountability. In educational institutions, clear supervisory alignment ensures consistent directives, enhances task efficiency, streamlines operational workflows, and maintains organizational stability.

question_english: In educational administration and organizational theory, the term 'Scalar Chain' refers to which of the following structural concepts?
options_english: The standardized grading and classification matrix utilized for evaluating student academic achievement
The formal, unbroken line of authority and communication extending from the highest administrative executive to the frontline personnel
The statutory pay band and salary hierarchy prescribed for institutional teaching and non-teaching staff
The logistical supply chain network established for procuring and distributing educational learning materials
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). The Scalar Chain, articulated by Henri Fayol, refers to the unbroken, hierarchical line of authority, communication, and operational governance extending from top institutional leadership down to the lowest organizational ranks. In school administration, formal instructions, requests, approvals, and reports must travel systematically along this scalar path to preserve structural order and institutional accountability. Fayol provided for an exception called the 'gangplank' (level jumping) only during operational emergencies between peers to prevent administrative bottlenecks. Options (a), (c), and (d) describe unrelated academic grading, compensation matrices, and logistics management systems respectively.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। हेनरी फेयोल द्वारा प्रतिपादित 'सोपान श्रृंखला' (Scalar Chain) का आशय सर्वोच्च प्रशासनिक पद से लेकर संगठन के निम्नतम स्तर तक विस्तृत प्राधिकार और संचार की औपचारिक व अटूट रेखा से है। विद्यालय प्रशासन में सभी दिशा-निर्देश, प्रतिवेदन और औपचारिक संवाद इसी पदसोपानिक मार्ग से होकर गुजरते हैं जिससे व्यवस्था और जवाबदेही बनी रहे। आपातकालीन परिस्थितियों में विलंब से बचने के लिए फेयोल ने समान स्तर के सहकर्मियों के मध्य प्रत्यक्ष संचार हेतु 'गैंगप्लैंक' (Gangplank) का प्रावधान किया था। विकल्प (a) ग्रेडिंग व्यवस्था, विकल्प (c) वेतनमान और विकल्प (d) सामग्री आपूर्ति से संबंधित हैं जो सोपान श्रृंखला के अर्थ से सर्वथा भिन्न हैं।

question_hindi:
विद्यालय की समय-सारणी (टाइम-टेबल) के निर्माण को नियंत्रित करने वाले शैक्षणिक और मनोवैज्ञानिक सिद्धांतों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. उच्च संज्ञानात्मक एकाग्रता की मांग करने वाले विषयों (जैसे गणित और विज्ञान) को विद्यालय दिवस के अंतिम कालखंडों (पीरियड्स) में निर्धारित किया जाना चाहिए।
II. विविधता का सिद्धांत यह निर्देश देता है कि लगातार दो कालखंड एक ही विषय को आवंटित नहीं किए जाने चाहिए, जब तक कि प्रयोगशाला या प्रायोगिक कार्य हेतु ऐसा करना आवश्यक न हो।
III. मानसिक थकान और शिथिलता के प्रभाव को कम करने के लिए कठिन विषयों के बीच पर्याप्त विश्राम और मध्यांतर उपलब्ध कराए जाने चाहिए।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
options_hindi: केवल I और II
केवल II और III
केवल I और III
I, II और III

question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the pedagogical and psychological principles governing the construction of a school timetable:
I. Subjects demanding intense cognitive concentration (such as Mathematics and Science) should ideally be scheduled in the concluding periods of the school day.
II. The principle of variety requires that consecutive periods should generally not be allotted to the identical academic subject, unless laboratory or practical work necessitates it.
III. The physiological and psychological incidence of mental fatigue necessitates providing adequate short recesses and breaks between challenging instructional periods.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (b). The construction of a school timetable is governed by sound educational psychology and administrative principles:
- Statement I is incorrect: Pedagogical studies demonstrate that students experience peak cognitive freshness, alertness, and mental energy during the early morning periods. Hence, cognitively demanding subjects like Mathematics, Sciences, and Grammar must be scheduled in the earlier periods, not in the later periods when mental fatigue sets in.
- Statement II is correct: The principle of variety avoids cognitive monotony and sustained disengagement by alternating demanding subjects with creative, linguistic, or recreational activities.
- Statement III is correct: The incidence of physical and mental fatigue requires strategically timed short breaks, play intervals, and recess periods to rejuvenate attention and optimize learning efficiency.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। विद्यालयीन समय-सारणी का निर्माण मनोवैज्ञानिक और शैक्षणिक सिद्धांतों पर आधारित होता है:
- कथन I गलत है: मनोवैज्ञानिक शोध यह सिद्ध करते हैं कि सुबह के समय विद्यार्थियों की मानसिक ऊर्जा और एकाग्रता का स्तर उच्चतम होता है। इसलिए अत्यधिक बौद्धिक परिश्रम वाले विषयों (जैसे गणित, भौतिकी आदि) को प्रातःकालीन प्रथम तीन-चार कालखंडों में रखा जाना चाहिए, न कि अंतिम कालखंडों में जब छात्र थकान महसूस करने लगते हैं।
- कथन II सही है: विविधता का सिद्धांत मानसिक ऊब और थकान को रोकने के लिए विभिन्न प्रकार के विषयों को क्रमबद्ध रूप से बदलने की अनुशंसा करता है।
- कथन III सही है: मानसिक शिथिलता को दूर करने और छात्रों की सीखने की क्षमता को बनाए रखने हेतु कठिन कालखंडों के मध्य उपयुक्त मध्यांतर व विश्राम देना आवश्यक है।
अतः केवल कथन II और III सही हैं।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) II and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Constructing an effective school timetable requires applying key pedagogical and psychological principles. Subjects requiring intense cognitive effort must be scheduled during early periods when mental energy peaks, rather than late periods. Alternating distinct subject types maintains interest and prevents mental saturation, while built-in rest periods alleviate fatigue, ensuring sustained attention and optimal classroom performance throughout the day.

question_hindi: शिक्षा में संपूर्ण गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन (TQM) निरंतर संस्थागत सुधार हेतु मूल रूप से डेमिंग चक्र (Deming Cycle / PDCA) पर निर्भर करता है। इस चक्र के चार क्रमिक चरण कौन-से हैं?
options_hindi: योजना बनाएं, निर्देशित करें, जांचें, कार्य करें (Plan, Direct, Check, Act)
योजना बनाएं, क्रियान्वित करें, जांचें, सुधार करें (Plan, Do, Check, Act)
तैयार करें, क्रियान्वित करें, संशोधित करें, विश्लेषण करें (Prepare, Do, Correct, Analyze)
योजना बनाएं, करें, नियंत्रित करें, मूल्यांकन करें (Plan, Do, Control, Assess)
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals

question_english: Total Quality Management (TQM) in educational administration relies fundamentally on the Deming Cycle (Shewhart Cycle) for continuous institutional improvement. What are the four sequential stages of this cycle?
options_english: Plan, Direct, Check, Act
Plan, Do, Check, Act
Prepare, Do, Correct, Analyze
Plan, Do, Control, Assess
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (b). The Deming Cycle—originally developed by Walter Shewhart and popularized globally by W. Edwards Deming—is an iterative four-step management framework for continuous quality improvement (CQI):
1. Plan: Identify institutional problems, analyze root causes, set measurable educational objectives, and formulate action strategies.
2. Do: Implement the formulated plan on a pilot or operational scale.
3. Check (or Study): Systematically monitor, measure, and evaluate the outcomes against benchmarked standards.
4. Act: Standardize successful interventions, correct deviations, and embed improvements permanently into institutional workflows.
Options (a), (c), and (d) substitute non-standard management terms.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। डॉ. डब्ल्यू. एडवर्ड्स डेमिंग द्वारा लोकप्रिय बनाया गया 'डेमिंग चक्र' (जिसे शेवार्ट चक्र या PDCA चक्र भी कहा जाता है) गुणवत्ता में निरंतर सुधार की एक चक्रीय प्रक्रिया है जिसके चार प्रमुख चरण हैं:
1. Plan (योजना बनाएं): संस्थागत समस्याओं का विश्लेषण कर लक्ष्यों और कार्य-योजनाओं का निर्धारण करना।
2. Do (क्रियान्वित करें): बनाई गई योजना को प्रायोगिक या प्रत्यक्ष स्तर पर लागू करना।
3. Check (जांचें / अध्ययन करें): परिणामों का मूल्यांकन और निरीक्षण करना कि क्या वे निर्धारित मानकों के अनुरूप हैं।
4. Act (सुधार करें / मानक स्थापित करें): सफल परिणामों को संस्थागत कार्यप्रणाली में स्थायी रूप से शामिल करना और कमियों को दूर करना।
अतः सही विकल्प (b) है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Plan, Do, Check, Act

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Deming Cycle, also known as the PDCA cycle, provides a continuous quality improvement framework in educational management. The process begins with planning objectives and processes, followed by implementing the plan during the do phase. Next, outcomes are evaluated in the check phase, and final corrective actions are implemented during the act phase to ensure sustained institutional growth.

question_english: Within the framework of a strategic SWOT (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) analysis conducted for a secondary school, which of the following factors exemplifies an 'Opportunity'?
options_english: State educational policies offering competitive developmental grants for augmenting institutional digital and technological infrastructure
A dedicated, well-qualified, and highly experienced teaching faculty across major academic disciplines
Dilapidated, insufficient, and technologically obsolete equipment in core science laboratories
Elevated student dropout rates and declining secondary school enrollment trends in the adjacent local catchment area
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (a). In a strategic SWOT analysis, Opportunities (O) and Threats (T) are external environmental conditions, whereas Strengths (S) and Weaknesses (W) are internal organizational factors:
- Option (a) is an Opportunity because government grant schemes and policies originate externally from the state, offering favorable avenues for the institution to enhance its digital learning infrastructure.
- Option (b) is an internal Strength (organizational competence and human capital).
- Option (c) is an internal Weakness (infrastructural deficiency within institutional control).
- Option (d) is an external Threat (adverse demographic and socioeconomic community conditions threatening enrollment).
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (a) है। सामरिक SWOT विश्लेषण में ताकत (Strengths) और कमजोरियां (Weaknesses) आंतरिक घटक होते हैं, जबकि अवसर (Opportunities) और चुनौतियां/खतरे (Threats) बाह्य परिवेश से जुड़े होते हैं:
- विकल्प (a) एक बाह्य 'अवसर' है क्योंकि सरकारी नीतियां और तकनीकी विकास अनुदान विद्यालय के बाहर से प्राप्त होते हैं, जिनका लाभ उठाकर विद्यालय अपनी शिक्षण अवसंरचना को आधुनिक बना सकता है।
- विकल्प (b) आंतरिक 'ताकत' (योग्य मानव संसाधन) है।
- विकल्प (c) आंतरिक 'कमजोरी' (जर्जर प्रयोगशाला सुविधाएं) है।
- विकल्प (d) बाह्य 'संकट/चुनौती' (सामुदायिक स्तर पर ड्रॉपआउट और कम नामांकन) है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) State policies offering special development grants for institutional technology infrastructure

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In a SWOT analysis, opportunities represent favorable external factors that an institution can leverage to enhance performance. Special government grants for technological infrastructure originate outside the school but provide valuable financial support to modernize learning environments. In contrast, internal capabilities count as strengths, internal physical deficiencies represent weaknesses, and unfavorable external community conditions operate as environmental threats.

question_english: In the matrix of SWOT analysis applied to institutional evaluation, which pair of components represents the 'Internal' organizational environment of a school?
options_english: Opportunities and Threats
Strengths and Opportunities
Strengths and Weaknesses
Weaknesses and Threats
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (c). SWOT analysis classifies organizational variables into two fundamental dimensions:
1. Internal Factors: Strengths (S) and Weaknesses (W), which represent institutional capabilities, competencies, physical resources, staff performance, and operational constraints that are directly under the internal control and governance of the school administration.
2. External Factors: Opportunities (O) and Threats (T), which emerge from the macro-environment—including educational policies, regulatory mandates, socioeconomic trends, demographic changes, and technological disruptions outside the institution's direct control.
Therefore, Strengths and Weaknesses constitute the internal factors.
explanation_hindi:

2. बाह्य कारक: अवसर (Opportunities) और चुनौतियां/संकट (Threats) — ये विद्यालय के बाहरी वातावरण से उत्पन्न होते हैं, जैसे सरकारी नीतियां, सामाजिक-आर्थिक रुझान, तकनीकी विकास और सामुदायिक अपेक्षाएं।
अतः ताकत और कमजोरियां आंतरिक कारकों का युग्म हैं।

Strengths and weaknesses are internal attributes, reflecting existing resources, staff competencies, physical infrastructure, and operational deficiencies under organizational control. question_english: Under the General Financial Rules (GFR) and governmental accounting standards governing institutional record management, what is the mandatory prescribed retention period for a school Cash Book?
options_english: 3 years
5 years
10 years
Permanent retention
explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). According to the General Financial Rules (GFR) and Appendix 13 of the Central Public Works/Accounts Code regarding record retention schedules, accounting registers such as Cash Books (along with subsidiary cash registers) must be preserved for a minimum period of 10 years after closure, subject to completion of statutory audits. Because the cash book documents all daily institutional financial inflows, payments, vouchers, and balances, it is vital for statutory audit compliance, vigilance inquiries, and financial accountability. Options (a) and (b) are shorter than the mandated retention period. Option (d) applies to permanent statutory registers such as the student Admission and Withdrawal Register or Service Books, rather than routine cash books.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। सामान्य वित्तीय नियमावली (GFR) और अभिलेख प्रतिधारण अनुसूची के वैधानिक प्रावधानों के अनुसार, विद्यालय के वित्तीय संव्यवहारों को दर्ज करने वाली मुख्य 'रोकड़ बही' (Cash Book) को बंद होने के बाद न्यूनतम 10 वर्षों की अवधि के लिए सुरक्षित रखा जाना अनिवार्य है, बशर्ते संबंधित वर्षों का सांविधिक वित्तीय अंकेक्षण (ऑडिट) पूर्ण हो चुका हो। रोकड़ बही में सभी दैनिक नकद लेन-देन, चालान और वाउचर का ब्योरा होता है, इसलिए वित्तीय जवाबदेही और ऑडिट सत्यापन हेतु 10 वर्ष की सीमा निर्धारित की गई है। विकल्प (a) और (b) निर्धारित सीमा से कम हैं। विकल्प (d) स्थायी अभिलेखों (जैसे छात्र प्रवेश व निकासी रजिस्टर) पर लागू होता है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) 10 years

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: General Financial Rules specify mandatory record retention schedules to ensure legal compliance, financial transparency, and accountability in administrative management. A cash book serves as a vital financial record documenting all daily cash transactions, receipts, and payments. Due to its audit significance and accounting necessity, financial regulations mandate that cash books be preserved for a minimum period of ten years.

question_english: Which institutional record serves as the most critical permanent legal document detailing a student's initial enrollment, personal demographics, academic progression, and formal departure from the school?
options_english: The Daily Student Attendance Register
The Official Institutional Log Book
The Admission and Withdrawal Register
The Student Cumulative Anecdotal Record
explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). The Admission and Withdrawal Register (often termed the Scholar's Register or General Register) is the primary permanent statutory document maintained by an educational institution. It documents an unbroken legal record of every pupil admitted, including full name, parentage, date of birth, caste/category, date of admission, enrollment number, academic progress/class progression, and date and cause of withdrawal/issuance of school leaving certificate. By statutory education department rules, this register must be preserved permanently. Option (a) is typically retained for a limited duration (e.g., 3-5 years). Option (b), the Log Book, records special events, official visits, and inspections. Option (d) tracks qualitative behavioral anecdotes and is maintained during the pupil's tenure.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। प्रवेश एवं निकासी रजिस्टर (स्कॉलर रजिस्टर / जनरल रजिस्टर) विद्यालय का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण स्थायी विधिक और प्रशासनिक अभिलेख होता है। इसमें विद्यालय में प्रवेश लेने वाले प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी का पूरा नाम, जन्मतिथि, माता-पिता का नाम, श्रेणी, प्रवेश की तिथि, कक्षा-दर-कक्षा प्रगति तथा विद्यालय छोड़ने (स्थानांतरण प्रमाण पत्र जारी करने) का स्थायी ब्योरा दर्ज होता है। शिक्षा संहिताओं के अनुसार इस रजिस्टर को संस्था में स्थायी रूप से संरक्षित रखा जाता है। विकल्प (a) उपस्थिति रजिस्टर एक अस्थायी रिकॉर्ड है। विकल्प (b) लॉग बुक विद्यालय के महत्वपूर्ण आयोजनों और निरीक्षण टिप्पणियों के लिए होती है। विकल्प (d) छात्रों के गुणात्मक व्यवहार संबंधी अभिलेख हैं।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) The Admission and Withdrawal Register

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The admission and withdrawal register serves as the principal official document tracking a student’s formal connection with an institution. It permanently records critical details including entry dates, personal demographics, academic progress, and eventual withdrawal. Due to its permanent legal and administrative value for verification, record verification, and institutional history, it is preserved permanently within educational recordkeeping systems.

question_hindi:

अभिकथन (A): किसी शैक्षणिक संस्था के प्रमुख को वर्ष में कम से कम एक बार सभी संस्थागत वस्तुओं और भंडार सामग्री का आवधिक भौतिक सत्यापन करना/कराना चाहिए तथा इसका सत्यापन प्रमाण-पत्र स्टॉक रजिस्टर में दर्ज करना चाहिए।

question_english:
Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): The Head of an educational institution must conduct or cause to be conducted periodic physical verification of all institutional stock and store articles at least once a year and record the certificate of verification in the Stock Register.
Reason (R): Mandatory physical verification under General Financial Rules safeguards public assets against pilferage, reconciles physical quantities with book balances, and identifies damaged or obsolete articles for condemnation and write-off.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Rule 213 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 specifies that physical verification of fixed assets and consumable goods should be conducted at least once a year by the Head of the Office or an authorized verification committee. The actual inventory must be reconciled against the balances recorded in the consumable and non-consumable stock registers. This periodic physical check ensures transparency, exposes pilferage, deters misappropriation, verifies wear and tear, and facilitates administrative procedures to condemn obsolete goods. Therefore, both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are factually true, and Reason (R) provides the exact rationale for Assertion (A).
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सामान्य वित्तीय नियमावली (GFR, 2017) के नियम 213 के अनुसार, संस्था प्रमुख या नामित सत्यापन समिति द्वारा वर्ष में कम से कम एक बार स्थायी परिसंपत्तियों और उपभोग्य सामग्रियों का अनिवार्य भौतिक सत्यापन किया जाना चाहिए तथा सत्यापन का प्रमाण-पत्र स्टॉक पंजिका में अभिलिखित किया जाना चाहिए। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य कागजी शेष और वास्तविक भंडार का मिलान करना, किसी भी प्रकार की चोरी, गबन या क्षति को रोकना तथा निष्प्रयोज्य हो चुकी सामग्रियों की पहचान कर उन्हें बट्टे खाते में डालने (कंडेमनेशन) की वैधानिक प्रक्रिया को पूरा करना है। अतः अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सटीक व्याख्या करता है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Statutory financial regulations require heads of institutions to conduct periodic physical verifications of all stock items. Physically auditing inventory helps verify actual balances against written records, preventing misappropriation, loss, or theft. It also enables administrators to identify damaged or obsolete equipment for disposal. Therefore, regulatory compliance and operational accountability justify mandatory regular physical verification of institutional assets.

question_hindi: शैक्षिक प्रशासन और प्रबंधन के संदर्भ में, 'पर्यवेक्षण' (Supervision) और 'निरीक्षण' (Inspection) के बीच के मूलभूत अंतर को निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन स्पष्ट करता है?

question_english: In the context of educational governance and administration, which of the following delineates the fundamental distinction between 'Supervision' and 'Inspection'?
options_english: Inspection concentrates exclusively on nurturing professional development, whereas supervision is primarily restricted to bureaucratic fault-finding
Inspection represents an ongoing, formative developmental process, whereas supervision operates as a sporadic, summative administrative review
Inspection governs only instructional classroom personnel, whereas supervision applies exclusively to ministerial and non-teaching employees
Inspection evaluates formal compliance with statutory rules and institutional standards, whereas supervision focuses on guiding and supporting teachers' professional growth to enhance instruction
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). In modern educational theory, inspection and supervision have distinct philosophical and functional orientations:
- Inspection is predominantly an external, periodic, and evaluative administrative audit designed to assess an institution's adherence to statutory regulations, infrastructure standards, financial compliance, and curricula mandates. Traditionally, inspection has been evaluative and compliance-oriented.
- Supervision, in contrast, is an internal, ongoing, collaborative, and democratic process aimed at improving the teaching-learning situation. It provides pedagogical guidance, constructive feedback, coaching, and professional development to instructional staff.
Options (a) and (b) invert their core characteristics. Option (c) is factually incorrect as both functions touch pedagogical activities.

question_english: Modern educational supervision has evolved from authoritarian administrative inspection toward 'Clinical Supervision'. Which of the following constitutes the central defining feature of clinical supervision?
options_english: Unannounced surprise inspections conducted by external administrative authorities to identify operational discrepancies
A collaborative, formative, multi-stage observational cycle involving the supervisor and teacher to improve classroom instruction
Mandatory annual medical and diagnostic health evaluations conducted for institutional staff members
The enforcement of punitive administrative sanctions against teachers who fail to complete the syllabus within prescribed timeframes
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Clinical supervision, conceptualized by Morris Cogan and Robert Goldhammer, is an intensive, face-to-face, collaborative model of instructional supervision designed to improve classroom pedagogical practice. It typically proceeds through structured cyclical phases: pre-observation conference (planning focus), systematic classroom observation, data analysis, post-observation conference (collaborative feedback and analysis), and post-conference analysis. Option (a) describes traditional authoritarian inspection. Option (c) is a literal misinterpretation of the word 'clinical'. Option (d) describes bureaucratic punitive coercion.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। मॉरिस कोगन और रॉबर्ट गोल्डहैमर द्वारा विकसित 'नैदानिक पर्यवेक्षण' (Clinical Supervision) कक्षा शिक्षण में गुणात्मक सुधार लाने के लिए पर्यवेक्षक और शिक्षक के बीच एक सहयोगात्मक, प्रत्यक्ष और संरचित प्रक्रिया है। इसमें मुख्य रूप से पाँच चरण होते हैं: अवलोकन-पूर्व बैठक (योजना बनाना), प्रत्यक्ष कक्षा अवलोकन, आंकड़ों का विश्लेषण, अवलोकन-पश्चात संगोष्ठी (रचनात्मक प्रतिपुष्टि) और भावी सुधार की योजना। विकल्प (a) परंपरागत औचक निरीक्षण को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (c) 'नैदानिक' शब्द का गलत शाब्दिक अर्थ निकालता है। विकल्प (d) दंडात्मक नौकरशाही दृष्टिकोण है जो आधुनिक पर्यवेक्षण के दर्शन के विपरीत है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Clinical supervision emphasizes close collaboration between supervisors and educators to refine pedagogical practices. Rather than conducting detached evaluations, supervisors engage in structured pre-observation planning, systematic classroom observations, and supportive post-observation conferences. This cyclical process analyzes instructional methodologies constructively, enhances teaching competencies, promotes teacher self-reflection, and directly improves student learning outcomes within educational institutions.

question_english: Which of the following activities does NOT constitute a legitimate stage in the classic cycle of clinical supervision?
options_english: Pre-observation planning conference
Direct systematic classroom observation
Post-observation analytical feedback conference
Conducting a formal disciplinary hearing and initiating salary deductions
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). The clinical supervision model is non-punitive, collaborative, and developmental. Its classic phases encompass: (1) Pre-observation conference to establish mutual goals and observational criteria, (2) Systematic classroom observation to collect objective instructional data, (3) Data analysis and strategy session, (4) Post-observation conference to share insights and foster teacher self-reflection, and (5) Evaluation of the supervisory cycle. Conducting punitive disciplinary hearings or effecting salary reductions belongs to bureaucratic corrective administration and legal service rule enforcement, which is diametrically opposed to the developmental tenets of clinical supervision. Options (a), (b), and (c) are foundational stages of the cycle.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। नैदानिक पर्यवेक्षण का उद्देश्य शिक्षकों का व्यावसायिक विकास और शिक्षण गुणवत्ता को उन्नत करना है, न कि उन्हें दंडित करना। इसके प्रमुख चरणों में अवलोकन-पूर्व बैठक, कक्षा अवलोकन, आंकड़ों का विश्लेषण, और अवलोकन-पश्चात प्रतिपुष्टि बैठक शामिल हैं। अनुशासनात्मक सुनवाई करना और वेतन में कटौती करना दंडात्मक नौकरशाही प्रक्रियाएं हैं, जिनका संबंध सेवा नियमों के उल्लंघन से होता है, शैक्षणिक नैदानिक पर्यवेक्षण से नहीं। अतः विकल्प (d) नैदानिक पर्यवेक्षण चक्र का घटक नहीं है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Clinical supervision relies entirely on formative development, pedagogical coaching, and collegial problem-solving rather than administrative punishment. Punitive measures, such as disciplinary hearings or salary deductions, contradict the core developmental philosophy of clinical supervision and undermine professional trust.

question_english: Peer supervision and collaborative peer coaching among school educators offer significant pedagogical advantages primarily because:
options_english: It legally absolves the school Principal of all statutory institutional documentation and monitoring obligations
It cultivates a collegial professional learning community, promotes reflective practice, and mitigates the anxiety often associated with evaluative supervision
It formally supersedes and replaces the statutory Annual Performance Assessment Reports (APAR/ACR) mandated by the government
It statutorily authorizes senior faculty members to terminate probationary or ad-hoc teaching staff
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Peer supervision (or peer coaching) involves practicing teachers observing one another's classrooms, discussing pedagogical strategies, and sharing constructive feedback in a non-threatening, collegial atmosphere. Because peer coaches hold equal institutional standing without formal evaluative authority, this practice substantially diminishes the anxiety and defensiveness typically induced by managerial appraisal. Furthermore, it nurtures a vibrant Professional Learning Community (PLC) that encourages shared pedagogical exploration. Option (a) is incorrect because administrative record-keeping remains a statutory principal duty. Option (c) is false because official annual performance appraisals cannot be superseded by peer coaching. Option (d) is legally absurd.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। सहकर्मी पर्यवेक्षण (Peer Supervision / Peer Coaching) में समान स्तर के शिक्षक एक-दूसरे की कक्षाओं का अवलोकन करते हैं और शिक्षण पद्धतियों पर रचनात्मक विचार-विमर्श करते हैं। चूँकि इसमें कोई औपचारिक मूल्यांकन या दंडात्मक अधिकार शामिल नहीं होता, इसलिए यह शिक्षकों में मूल्यांकन के प्रति होने वाले तनाव और भय को समाप्त करता है। यह विद्यालय में एक जीवंत 'व्यावसायिक शिक्षण समुदाय' (PLC) और चिंतनशील शिक्षण संस्कृति को विकसित करता है। विकल्प (a) गलत है क्योंकि संस्था प्रमुख के वैधानिक दायित्व समाप्त नहीं होते। विकल्प (c) गलत है क्योंकि यह आधिकारिक ACR/APAR का विकल्प नहीं है। विकल्प (d) कानूनी रूप से निराधार है।

question_english: In the context of academic leadership and educational management, 'Mentoring' is best characterized as:

An annual summative appraisal procedure centered exclusively on aggregate student standardized test performance
An administrative arrangement utilized by senior managers to offload routine clerical and logistical chores onto junior faculty

A sustained, collaborative developmental relationship through which an experienced educator facilitates the professional learning, psychosocial growth, and career socialization of a less experienced colleague
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Mentoring in educational management is a long-term, supportive, and reciprocal professional relationship. An experienced and seasoned educator (mentor) provides instructional guidance, emotional support, institutional acculturation, and career counseling to a novice or less-experienced colleague (mentee). Unlike punitive or purely evaluative administrative mechanisms, mentoring focuses holistically on teacher empowerment, pedagogical mastery, self-efficacy, and retention. Option (a) describes performance monitoring. Option (b) refers to value-added teacher appraisal based on test scores. Option (c) describes bureaucratic delegation.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। शैक्षिक संदर्भ में 'मेंटरिंग' (संबोधन / मेंटरशिप) एक सतत, सहयोगात्मक और विकासात्मक संबंध है जहाँ एक अनुभवी और दक्ष शिक्षक (मेंटर) किसी नए या कम अनुभवी शिक्षक (मेंटी) को शिक्षण विधियों, कक्षा प्रबंधन, संस्थागत संस्कृति और व्यावसायिक चुनौतियों से निपटने में मार्गदर्शन और भावनात्मक संबल प्रदान करता है। इसका उद्देश्य शिक्षक के आत्मविश्वास, विषयगत दक्षता और व्यावसायिक पहचान को सुदृढ़ बनाना है। विकल्प (a) उपचारात्मक या अनुशासनात्मक निगरानी को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (b) मानकीकृत परीक्षण आधारित मूल्यांकन है। विकल्प (c) लिपिकीय कार्यों का विकेंद्रीकरण मात्र है।

question_english: Which classical leadership perspective posits that effective leaders are distinguished by inborn, inherent physiological and psychological qualities—such as superior intellect, emotional stability, self-confidence, and drive—rather than acquired competencies?
options_english: Situational Leadership Theory
Trait Theory of Leadership
Behavioural Theory of Leadership
Contingency Theory of Leadership
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). The Trait Theory of leadership (often traced back to Thomas Carlyle's 19th-century 'Great Man' theory) asserts that leadership potential is inherent rather than developed; leaders are born, not made. Early researchers attempted to isolate specific physical, intellectual, and personality characteristics (such as high intelligence, verbal fluency, emotional resilience, drive, integrity, and sociability) that separated leaders from non-leaders. Option (a), Situational Theory, emphasizes adjusting style to follower readiness. Option (c), Behavioural Theory, argues that leadership consists of learnable actions and styles. Option (d), Contingency Theory, maintains that effectiveness depends on matching leadership style with situational context.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नेतृत्व का 'शीलगुण या गुण सिद्धांत' (Trait Theory), जो 19वीं सदी के 'महान व्यक्ति सिद्धांत' (Great Man Theory) से प्रेरित है, यह मानता है कि नेता जन्मजात होते हैं, बनाए नहीं जाते। इस सिद्धांत के अनुसार प्रभावी नेताओं में कुछ प्राकृतिक और अंतर्निहित बौद्धिक, शारीरिक व व्यक्तित्व संबंधी लक्षण—जैसे असाधारण बुद्धिमत्ता, संप्रेषण क्षमता, आत्मविश्वास, दूरदर्शिता और नेतृत्व करने की तीव्र इच्छा—मौजूद होते हैं। विकल्प (a) परिस्थितिपरक सिद्धांत अनुयायियों की परिपक्वता पर जोर देता है। विकल्प (c) व्यवहारवादी सिद्धांत यह मानता है कि नेतृत्व का व्यवहार सीखा और सिखाया जा सकता है। विकल्प (d) आकस्मिकता सिद्धांत नेता के व्यवहार और परिस्थिति के मध्य सामंजस्य पर आधारित है।

question_english: In the seminal leadership research conducted at Ohio State University in the late 1940s and 1950s, which two foundational dimensions of leader behavior were isolated and identified using the Leader Behavior Description Questionnaire (LBDQ)?

Task structure and Position power

explanation_english:
The correct answer is (c). The landmark Ohio State University leadership studies (directed by Ralph Stogdill and Hemphill) narrowed hundreds of leadership behaviors down to two distinct, independent behavioral dimensions:
1. Initiating Structure: Task-oriented behavior wherein the leader defines roles, establishes formal communication channels, plans work, and schedules activities to attain operational goals.
2. Consideration: Relationship-oriented behavior characterized by mutual trust, warmth, respect for subordinates' ideas, open communication, and genuine concern for staff welfare.
Option (a) represents the two dimensions identified by the University of Michigan studies (Rensis Likert). Option (b) represents two of the situational variables in Fiedler's contingency model. Option (d) describes modern leadership paradigms introduced by James MacGregor Burns and Bernard Bass.

question_english: According to Robert Blake and Jane Mouton's Managerial Grid, an educational leader who concurrently exhibits high concern for organizational production/tasks and high concern for people/relationships is practicing which leadership style?
options_english: Impoverished Management (1,1)
Authority-Compliance Management (9,1)
Country Club Management (1,9)
Team Management (9,9)
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). Blake and Mouton's Managerial Grid plots managerial leadership styles across two axes (each rated from 1 to 9): Concern for Production (X-axis) and Concern for People (Y-axis):
- (9,9) Team Management: High concern for both production and people. Work accomplishments are attained through committed, empowered individuals who share institutional goals within an atmosphere of mutual trust and respect. This is considered the optimal leadership archetype.
- (1,1) Impoverished Management: Minimum effort exerted on both dimensions.
- (9,1) Authority-Compliance (Produce-or-Perish): Maximum focus on task completion with minimal concern for human factors.
- (1,9) Country Club Management: Thoughtful attention to human needs at the expense of production efficiency.

I. नेतृत्व की प्रभावशीलता मूलतः नेता की अंतर्निहित शैली और उस सीमा के मध्य उपयुक्त मिलान पर निर्भर करती है जहाँ तक परिस्थिति नेता को नियंत्रण और प्रभाव प्रदान करती है।
II. फीडलर ने किसी व्यक्ति के नेतृत्व उन्मुखीकरण को मापने के लिए 'न्यूनतम पसंदीदा सहकर्मी' (Least Preferred Co-worker - LPC) प्रश्नावली का निर्माण किया।
III. उच्च LPC स्कोर कार्य-उन्मुख नेता को दर्शाता है, जबकि निम्न LPC स्कोर संबंध-उन्मुख नेता को दर्शाता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
options_hindi: केवल I
केवल I और II
केवल II और III

question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding Fred Fiedler's Contingency Model of leadership effectiveness:
I. Leadership effectiveness depends fundamentally on a proper match between a leader's inherent orientation and the degree of situational control and favorableness.
II. Fiedler designed the Least Preferred Co-worker (LPC) scale to measure an individual's underlying leadership orientation.
III. A high LPC score designates a task-motivated leader, whereas a low LPC score designates a relationship-motivated leader.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I only
I and II only
II and III only
I, II, and III
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (b). In Fred Fiedler's Contingency Theory:
- Statement I is correct: Leadership success is contingent upon matching the leader's fixed behavioral style with the favorableness of the situation (determined by leader-member relations, task structure, and position power).
- Statement II is correct: Fiedler developed the Least Preferred Co-worker (LPC) questionnaire to assess whether a leader is primarily task-oriented or relationship-oriented.
- Statement III is incorrect: The LPC scoring works in reverse of statement III. A person with a high LPC score describes their least preferred co-worker in relatively positive, sympathetic terms, indicating a relationship-oriented leadership style. Conversely, a person with a low LPC score evaluates their least preferred co-worker unfavorably, indicating a task-oriented leadership style. Therefore, only statements I and II are correct.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। फ्रेड फीडलर के आकस्मिकता सिद्धांत के अनुसार:
- कथन I सही है: नेता की प्रभावशीलता इस बात पर निर्भर करती है कि नेता की कार्यशैली और परिस्थिति के अनुकूल होने की डिग्री (नेता-सदस्य संबंध, कार्य संरचना और पद शक्ति) के बीच कितना सामंजस्य है।
- कथन II सही है: नेता की शैली निर्धारित करने के लिए फीडलर ने 'न्यूनतम पसंदीदा सहकर्मी' (LPC) प्रश्नावली विकसित की थी।
- कथन III गलत है: उच्च LPC स्कोर प्राप्त करने वाला व्यक्ति अपने सबसे कम पसंदीदा सहकर्मी का भी सकारात्मक मूल्यांकन करता है, जो 'संबंध-उन्मुख' (relationship-oriented) शैली को दर्शाता है। इसके विपरीत, निम्न LPC स्कोर वाला व्यक्ति 'कार्य-उन्मुख' (task-oriented) शैली को प्रदर्शित करता है।
अतः केवल कथन I और II सही हैं।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I and II

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Fiedler’s Contingency Theory posits that leadership effectiveness depends on matching a leader’s fixed style with situational favorableness. Fiedler utilized the Least Preferred Co-worker questionnaire to measure leadership orientation. A high score reflects a relationship-oriented style, whereas a low score indicates a task-oriented style. Thus, high scores correlate with relationship orientation, contradicting claims of task focus.

question_english:
Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): In Paul Hersey and Ken Blanchard's Situational Leadership Model, a 'Delegating' style (S4) is the most effective approach for leading followers who exhibit high developmental readiness (R4/M4).
Reason (R): Followers at the high readiness stage possess both high competence (ability) and high commitment (willingness/confidence) to assume responsibility, rendering intensive task direction and excessive supportive socio-emotional intervention unnecessary.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (a). In Hersey and Blanchard's Situational Leadership Theory (SLT), optimal leadership style is determined by the readiness/maturity level of the followers (M1 to M4):
- M4 / R4 followers are both 'able and willing' (or confident), demonstrating high task competence and intrinsic motivation.
- For M4 followers, the appropriate matching leadership style is 'Delegating' (S4), characterized by low task behavior and low relationship behavior. Over-directing or over-supporting highly competent and confident staff leads to micromanagement, resentment, and inefficiency. Empowering them with autonomy fosters peak operational productivity.
Therefore, both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and Reason (R) correctly explains Assertion (A).
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (a) है। हर्सी और ब्लैंचर्ड के परिस्थितिपरक नेतृत्व सिद्धांत में नेतृत्व शैली का चयन अनुयायियों की तत्परता/परिपक्वता स्तर (R1 से R4) पर निर्भर करता है:
- R4/M4 स्तर के अधीनस्थ कार्य करने में पूरी तरह 'सक्षम और इच्छुक' (उच्च क्षमता और उच्च विश्वास) होते हैं।

अतः अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।

question_english: In Hersey and Blanchard’s Situational Leadership Model, a leader employing the “Selling” style (S2) provides:
options_english: High task behavior and low relationship behavior
High task behavior and high relationship behavior
Low task behavior and high relationship behavior
Low task behavior and low relationship behavior
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (b). In the Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership Model, leadership style is matched to follower readiness (maturity level). The model defines four leadership styles:
1. S1: Telling / Directing (High task, Low relationship) – suited for followers with low competence and high commitment.
2. S2: Selling / Coaching (High task, High relationship) – suited for followers who possess low to moderate competence but exhibit high willingness and enthusiasm. The leader provides directive guidance on 'what' and 'how' to do tasks while offering intense supportive communication and coaching to sustain commitment.
3. S3: Participating / Supporting (Low task, High relationship) – suited for capable but cautious or insecure followers.
4. S4: Delegating (Low task, Low relationship) – suited for highly competent and committed followers.
Option (a) corresponds to S1 (Telling), option (c) corresponds to S3 (Participating), and option (d) corresponds to S4 (Delegating).
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। हर्सी और ब्लैंचर्ड के परिस्थितिजन्य नेतृत्व मॉडल (Situational Leadership Model) में नेता का व्यवहार अधीनस्थों की परिपक्वता और तत्परता स्तर पर निर्भर करता है। इस मॉडल में नेतृत्व की चार शैलियाँ हैं:
1. S1: निर्देश देना / टेलिंग (उच्च कार्य, निम्न संबंध व्यवहार) – यह कम क्षमता लेकिन उच्च प्रतिबद्धता वाले कर्मचारियों के लिए उपयुक्त है।
2. S2: समझाना / सेलिंग / कोचिंग (उच्च कार्य, उच्च संबंध व्यवहार) – यह उन कर्मचारियों के लिए है जिनमें क्षमता कम या मध्यम होती है परंतु उत्साह और तत्परता अधिक होती है। इसमें नेता कार्य संबंधी स्पष्ट निर्देश (उच्च कार्य व्यवहार) देने के साथ-साथ उनका मनोबल बढ़ाने के लिए गहन संवाद और संबल (उच्च संबंध व्यवहार) प्रदान करता है।
3. S3: सहभागिता / पार्टिसिपेटिंग (निम्न कार्य, उच्च संबंध व्यवहार) – यह सक्षम किंतु आत्मविश्वास की कमी वाले कर्मचारियों के लिए है।
4. S4: प्रत्यायोजन / डेलिगेटिंग (निम्न कार्य, निम्न संबंध व्यवहार) – यह पूर्णतः सक्षम और प्रतिबद्ध कर्मचारियों के लिए है।
अतः विकल्प (b) सही उत्तर है।

question_english: In educational administration and organizational behavior, Transactional Leadership is fundamentally based on:
options_english: An exchange process where followers are rewarded for meeting specific performance objectives
Inspiring followers to transcend their own self-interests for the greater good of the organization
Distributing administrative leadership tasks equally among all organizational members
Relying entirely on the charismatic personal appeal and magnetism of the institutional leader
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (a). Transactional leadership is fundamentally rooted in an exchange or contractual relationship between leader and follower. The leader sets clear performance targets, monitors compliance, and provides contingent rewards (praise, recognition, financial incentives) or corrective measures when targets are met or missed. Its primary aim is to maintain organizational stability and optimize existing operations.
Option (b) describes transformational leadership, which inspires staff to sacrifice self-interest for a collective vision. Option (c) describes distributed or shared leadership. Option (d) describes charismatic leadership.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (a) है। लेन-देन संबंधी (संव्यवहारवादी) नेतृत्व (Transactional Leadership) मूल रूप से नेता और अनुयायियों के बीच एक संविदात्मक विनिमय प्रक्रिया (Exchange Process) पर आधारित होता है। इसमें नेता कार्य-निष्पादन के स्पष्ट लक्ष्य निर्धारित करता है और कर्मचारियों द्वारा उन लक्ष्यों को पूरा करने पर उन्हें आकस्मिक पुरस्कार (Contingent Rewards) प्रदान करता है अथवा विचलन होने पर सुधारात्मक कदम उठाता है।
विकल्प (b) रूपांतरणकारी नेतृत्व (Transformational Leadership) का लक्षण है। विकल्प (c) वितरित नेतृत्व (Distributed Leadership) से संबंधित है। विकल्प (d) करिश्माई नेतृत्व (Charismatic Leadership) को दर्शाता है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Transactional leadership relies fundamentally on a contractual exchange between leaders and followers. Leaders establish clear performance expectations, define operational tasks, and provide specific rewards or apply correctives based on target compliance. This approach emphasizes maintaining organizational stability, enforcing existing operational rules, and achieving short-term goals through structured feedback, contingent rewards, and active administrative oversight.

question_hindi:

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Transformational leaders often utilize ‘Idealized Influence’ to act as strong role models for their followers.
Reason (R): Transformational leadership focuses purely on maintaining the status quo and ensuring strict compliance with existing rules.
options_english: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (c). Assertion (A) is true: In Bernard Bass's Transformational Leadership theory, 'Idealized Influence' is one of the four essential components (the '4 Is'). Leaders behave in exemplary ways that cause followers to identify with them, admire them, and place deep trust in their vision and integrity.
Reason (R) is false: Transformational leadership is fundamentally change-oriented and seeks to innovate, inspire higher-order growth, and transcend conventional routines. Maintaining the status quo and enforcing strict compliance with existing rules is the hallmark of transactional leadership and bureaucratic administration, not transformational leadership.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (c) है। अभिकथन (A) सही है: बर्नार्ड बास के रूपांतरणकारी नेतृत्व मॉडल में 'आदर्श प्रभाव' (Idealized Influence) प्रमुख चार घटकों में से एक है। इसके अंतर्गत नेता उच्च नैतिक मानकों और अनुकरणीय आचरण का प्रदर्शन करते हैं, जिससे अनुयायी उन्हें अपना रोल मॉडल मानते हैं और उन पर गहरा विश्वास करते हैं।
कारण (R) गलत है: रूपांतरणकारी नेतृत्व यथास्थिति (status quo) बनाए रखने या केवल मौजूदा नियमों के अनुपालन तक सीमित नहीं होता, बल्कि यह नवाचार, संगठनात्मक पुनर्संरचना और सर्वांगीण सुधार पर केंद्रित होता है। यथास्थिति बनाए रखना और कड़े नियमों का पालन कराना संव्यवहारवादी (Transactional) नेतृत्व की विशेषता है। अतः A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है।

Therefore, attributing rigid rule compliance and status quo maintenance to transformational leadership incorrectly describes its core philosophical focus.

question_english: The concept of ‘Distributed Leadership’ in a school environment implies that:
options_english: Administrative responsibilities are distributed strictly among senior administrative staff members based on tenure
Management duties are delegated entirely to external bodies such as the School Management Committee
The educational institution operates without defined organizational hierarchy or accountability structures
Leadership is a shared practice where individuals assume roles based on expertise rather than formal position
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). Distributed leadership conceives leadership not as an individual monopoly vested solely in the Principal, but as an interactive, collective practice distributed across multiple actors within the organization. Teachers, specialists, and administrators take on leadership functions dynamically based on their pedagogical expertise, professional competencies, and situational demands.
Option (a) incorrectly equates distributed leadership with tenure-based administrative delegation. Option (b) confuses distributed leadership with external outsourcing. Option (c) is incorrect because distributed leadership operates within structured accountability frameworks and does not eliminate formal roles.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। वितरित नेतृत्व (Distributed Leadership) की अवधारणा नेतृत्व को किसी एक व्यक्ति (जैसे केवल प्रधानाचार्य) का एकाधिकार नहीं मानती, बल्कि इसे पूरे विद्यालय में फैली हुई एक साझा एवं सहयोगात्मक प्रक्रिया मानती है। इसमें शिक्षक और अन्य कर्मचारी औपचारिक पद के बजाय अपनी विषय-विशेषज्ञता, कौशल और सामयिक आवश्यकताओं के आधार पर निर्णय लेने और पहल करने की जिम्मेदारी साझा करते हैं।
विकल्प (a) वरिष्ठता-आधारित कार्य-विभाजन की बात करता है जो गलत है। विकल्प (b) बाह्य एजेंसियों को कार्य सौंपने से संबंधित है। विकल्प (c) गलत है क्योंकि वितरित नेतृत्व में जवाबदेही और संस्थागत संरचना पूरी तरह बनी रहती है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Distributed leadership views management as a collective, interactive practice spread across multiple individuals within an educational institution. Rather than concentrating decision-making strictly in formal administrative roles, leadership responsibility shifts dynamically based on situational needs, expertise, and collaboration. This approach encourages shared decision-making, professional autonomy, and systemic problem-solving throughout the entire organizational community.

question_english: Instructional Leadership primarily requires the Head of the Institution to focus on:
options_english: Modernizing facility infrastructure and overseeing institutional financial accounts
Liaising with external political stakeholders to secure additional school funding
Improving teaching quality, guiding curriculum, and monitoring student outcomes

explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). While facility maintenance, fundraising, and administrative record-keeping (options a, b, and d) are necessary operational duties, they represent general administrative management rather than instructional leadership.
explanation_hindi:

question_hindi: अब्राहम मास्लो के आवश्यकता पदानुक्रम सिद्धांत (Hierarchy of Needs) के अनुसार, 'सुरक्षा संबंधी आवश्यकताओं' (Safety Needs) के पूर्ण होने के तुरंत बाद किस आवश्यकता की संतुष्टि आवश्यक होती है?

आत्मसम्मान और पद-प्रतिष्ठा की आवश्यकताएं (Esteem and Status Needs)
सामाजिक संबद्धता / अपनत्व की आवश्यकताएं (Social Belongingness Needs)
आत्म-साक्षात्कार की आवश्यकताएं (Self-Actualization Needs)

question_english: According to Abraham Maslow’s Hierarchy of Needs, which of the following needs must be satisfied immediately after ‘Safety Needs’ are met?
options_english: Physiological Needs
Esteem and Status Needs
Social Belongingness Needs
Self-Actualization Needs
explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Abraham Maslow's classic hierarchy of needs progresses sequentially through five levels: Physiological Needs -> Safety Needs -> Social Belongingness Needs -> Esteem Needs -> Self-Actualization Needs. Once safety and security needs (such as job stability, physical safety, and health) are satisfied, individuals become motivated primarily by social belongingness needs, including companionship, acceptance, teamwork, and affection. Esteem and self-actualization (options b and d) become prominent only after social belongingness is addressed.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। अब्राहम मास्लो के आवश्यकता पदानुक्रम में मानव प्रेरणा को पाँच क्रमिक स्तरों में व्यवस्थित किया गया है: 1. शारीरिक आवश्यकताएं -> 2. सुरक्षा की आवश्यकताएं -> 3. सामाजिक संबद्धता/अपनत्व की आवश्यकताएं -> 4. आत्मसम्मान की आवश्यकताएं -> 5. आत्म-साक्षात्कार। सुरक्षा आवश्यकताओं (जैसे नौकरी की सुरक्षा, स्थिरता) के पूरा होने के तुरंत बाद व्यक्ति अपनत्व, प्रेम, सामाजिक संबंध और समूह स्वीकृति की भावना से प्रेरित होता है। अतः विकल्प (c) सही उत्तर है।
topic: Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals

question_english: In Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory of motivation, which of the following is considered a ‘Motivator’ factor rather than a ‘Hygiene’ factor?
options_english: Salary
Working conditions
Interpersonal relations
Recognition
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). Frederick Herzberg's Motivation-Hygiene Theory bifurcates workplace elements into two distinct categories:
1. Hygiene Factors (Extrinsic): Salary, working conditions, organizational policies, supervision, and interpersonal relations. These prevent dissatisfaction when adequate, but their presence alone does not generate intrinsic motivation or high job performance.
2. Motivators (Intrinsic): Recognition, achievement, the work itself, responsibility, and advancement. These factors directly fulfill human needs for psychological growth and generate positive motivation and job satisfaction.
Therefore, recognition is a motivator, whereas salary, working conditions, and interpersonal relations (options a, b, and c) are hygiene factors.

1. आरोग्य / स्वच्छता कारक (Hygiene Factors): वेतन, कार्य दशाएं, संस्थागत नीतियां और पारस्परिक संबंध। ये कारक असंतोष को रोकते हैं, परंतु कर्मचारियों को आंतरिक रूप से बेहतर प्रदर्शन के लिए प्रेरित नहीं करते।
2. अभिप्रेरक कारक (Motivators): मान्यता (Recognition), कार्य में उपलब्धि (Achievement), उत्तरदायित्व और व्यक्तिगत विकास। ये आंतरिक कारक कार्य संतुष्टि और उच्च निष्पादन को जन्म देते हैं।

question_english: A Principal decides to give a challenging academic project to a teacher, believing the teacher enjoys taking responsibility and is highly creative. The Principal refrains from micromanaging the process. Which theoretical framework is guiding the Principal’s assumption?

question_english: According to Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, ‘Valence’ refers to:
options_english: The specific value or attractiveness an individual assigns to an outcome
The perceived probability that personal effort will yield successful performance
The expectation that achieving performance standards yields a specific reward
The perceived fairness of personal outcomes compared to organizational peers
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (a). In Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory (1964), motivation is a function of three variables: Motivation = Expectancy × Instrumentality × Valence. Valence refers to the affective orientation or value an individual places on an outcome or reward (how much they desire or fear it). If a teacher values professional recognition highly, the valence for that recognition is high and positive.
Option (b) defines Expectancy (Effort -> Performance belief). Option (c) defines Instrumentality (Performance -> Outcome belief). Option (d) describes Adams' Equity Theory.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (a) है। विक्टर व्रूम के प्रत्याशा सिद्धांत में अभिप्रेरणा तीन घटकों का गुणनफल होती है: अभिप्रेरणा = प्रत्याशा × साधनता × संयोजकता (M = E × I × V)। इसमें 'संयोजकता' (Valence) का अर्थ उस विशिष्ट मूल्य, वरीयता या आकर्षण से है जो कोई व्यक्ति किसी परिणाम या पुरस्कार को देता है।
विकल्प (b) 'प्रत्याशा' (Expectancy) को व्यक्त करता है। विकल्प (c) 'साधनता' (Instrumentality) को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (d) जे. स्टेसी एडम्स के समानता सिद्धांत (Equity Theory) से संबंधित है।

question_hindi:
संगठनात्मक संप्रेषण में प्रयुक्त जोहारी विंडो मॉडल (Johari Window Model) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. 'मुक्त क्षेत्र' (Open Area) उस जानकारी को दर्शाता है जो स्वयं को ज्ञात है और दूसरों को भी ज्ञात है।
II. 'अंध क्षेत्र' (Blind Area) उस जानकारी को दर्शाता है जो दूसरों को ज्ञात है परंतु स्वयं को अज्ञात है।
III. दूसरों से प्राप्त प्रतिपुष्टि (Feedback) 'अंध क्षेत्र' को कम करने में मदद करती है।
IV. आत्म-प्रकटीकरण (Self-disclosure) 'प्रच्छन्न क्षेत्र' (Hidden Area) को कम करने में मदद करता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
options_hindi: I और II
I, II, और III
II, III, और IV
I, II, III, और IV
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Human Resource Development: Concept and Goals

question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Johari Window model used in organizational communication:
I. The ‘Open Area’ represents information known to self and known to others.
II. The ‘Blind Area’ represents information known to others but unknown to self.
III. Feedback from others helps reduce the ‘Blind Area’.
IV. Self-disclosure helps reduce the ‘Hidden Area’.
Which of the above statements are correct?
options_english: I and II
I, II, and III
II, III, and IV
I, II, III, and IV
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). The Johari Window, devised by Joseph Luft and Harry Ingham, maps interpersonal awareness into four quadrants based on whether information is known/unknown to self and known/unknown to others:
1. Open Area (Arena): Known to self and known to others (Statement I is correct).
2. Blind Area (Blind Spot): Unknown to self, but known to others (Statement II is correct). Constructive feedback from team members reduces this quadrant by making the person aware of blind spots (Statement III is correct).
3. Hidden Area (Façade): Known to self, but unknown to others. Active self-disclosure reduces this quadrant by revealing information, thereby expanding the Open Area (Statement IV is correct).
4. Unknown Area: Unknown to self and unknown to others.
Since statements I, II, III, and IV are all correct, Option (d) is the right answer.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। जोसेफ लुफ्ट और हैरी इंगम द्वारा प्रतिपादित जोहारी विंडो मॉडल पारस्परिक संप्रेषण और आत्म-जागरूकता को चार चतुर्थांशों में बांटता है:
1. मुक्त क्षेत्र (Open Area): जो स्वयं को और दूसरों दोनों को ज्ञात है (कथन I सही है)।
2. अंध क्षेत्र (Blind Area): जो दूसरों को दिखाई देता है परंतु स्वयं को पता नहीं होता (कथन II सही है)। दूसरों से सकारात्मक फीडबैक लेने से यह अंध क्षेत्र घटता है (कथन III सही है)।
3. प्रच्छन्न क्षेत्र (Hidden Area): जो स्वयं को पता है किंतु दूसरों से छिपाकर रखा गया है। आत्म-प्रकटीकरण (Self-disclosure) से यह क्षेत्र कम होता है और खुला क्षेत्र बढ़ता है (कथन IV सही है)।
4. अज्ञात क्षेत्र (Unknown Area): जो न तो स्वयं को ज्ञात है और न दूसरों को।
अतः चारों कथन सही हैं और विकल्प (d) सही उत्तर है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II, III, and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Johari Window model categorizes interpersonal awareness across four quadrants based on self and external knowledge. The open area encompasses shared awareness, while the blind area contains traits known to others but unperceived by oneself. Constructive feedback effectively reduces the blind area, whereas active self-disclosure diminishes the hidden area, fostering enhanced communication, transparency, and trust within teams.

question_english: Two senior teachers are in conflict over the allocation of the physics laboratory schedule. The Principal listens to both, ignores the underlying issues, and simply dictates a schedule without discussing it further, telling them to ‘just deal with it’. Which conflict management style is the Principal employing?
options_english: Collaborating
Accommodating
Forcing (Competing)
Compromising
explanation_english:
The correct answer is (c). In the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument, the 'Forcing' (or 'Competing') style is characterized by high assertiveness and low cooperativeness. The leader uses formal positional power and unilateral authority to impose a solution without seeking consensus or addressing underlying relational grievances. While it brings quick resolution to the immediate operational stalemate, it often leaves lingering resentment.
Collaborating (option a) seeks a win-win integration. Accommodating (option b) involves yielding to others. Compromising (option d) involves mutual concessions to find an acceptable middle ground.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (c) है। थॉमस-किल्मन संघर्ष प्रबंधन मॉडल में, 'बलपूर्वक थोपना / प्रतिस्पर्धी शैली' (Forcing / Competing) उच्च दृढ़ता और निम्न सहकारिता को दर्शाती है। इसमें अधिकारी अपनी औपचारिक सत्ता और पद का उपयोग करके दोनों पक्षों की अंतर्निहित चिंताओं की उपेक्षा करते हुए एकतरफा निर्णय लागू कर देता है।
सहयोगात्मक शैली (विकल्प a) दोनों पक्षों के पारस्परिक समाधान पर बल देती है। समायोजनकारी शैली (विकल्प b) में दूसरे की बात मान ली जाती है। समझौतावादी शैली (विकल्प d) में दोनों पक्षों द्वारा कुछ त्याग करके मध्य मार्ग निकाला जाता है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Forcing (Competing)

question_english: In the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument, a ‘Collaborating’ style is characterized by:

explanation_english:
